question.text: Sahyadri Stat-Arb Fund (Cat III) holds INR 50 cr long in Stock X (Beta 1.5) and INR 75 cr short in Stock Y (Beta 1.0). Compute portfolio Beta on the long-short book (weights by absolute rupee value).

explanation.text: The Logic: Using the PDF Example 10.3 method, weights are signed investment / total sector investment. w_long = +50/125 = 0.40, w_short = -75/125 = -0.60. Portfolio Beta = 0.40*1.5 + (-0.60)*1.0 = 0.60 - 0.60 = 0.00. The book is exactly Beta-neutral. The Trap: Trap options misuse unsigned weights (would give 1.3), forget the sign on the short leg, or use a wrong denominator. A beta-neutral book can still be dollar-asymmetric. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-C tests same Beta calc. XXI-B tests Beta in a long-only PMS context.
